race.comment: THINK ITZ YOU (5) unplaced in the G2 Tulloch last March and should be near his top third up. Failed to close off when the sprint went on with a plugging fifth over 1600m at Warwick Farm. Ready for this distance range and shapes as a leading player. TACITLY (4) brings a solid SP profile here and has a good record over this track and trip. Placed over this trip here two back, then jumped in class and distance with a dismal eighth over 2070m at Gosford. Can slide across from the awkward gate and return to form. WIZARD'S STAR (9) is holding his form and no excuses today deep into the prep. Just under a month between runs with a fast finishing third over 1800m at Randwick Kensington. Well placed here and the blinkers come off. Each-way contender. DON'S PARTY (1) sprinted well first up to get the Maiden win out of the way at Wyong. Slow into stride at the latest with the 59kg and never got into the contest when sixth over 1625m at Wyong. Best form is good enough to figure prominently.
